description_en: Modifies the connection string of a cluster
description_zh: 调用ModifyDBInstanceConnectionString接口修改集群的连接地址
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse modify-db-instance-connection-string --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id cc-xxxxx --connection-string cc-2ze340000-clickhouse..clickhouseserver.pre.rds.aliyuncs.com --connection-string-prefix cc-0000-clickhouse --disable-ports 9001,8123 --db-instance-net-type Public --computing-group-id cc-2ze340000-clickhouse --api-version 2023-05-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceConnectionString

parameters.help_zh: 连接数据库的地址前辍
parameters.name: connection_string_prefix

parameters.help_en:
- The database ports to disable. You can specify multiple ports, separated by commas.

- This parameter is supported only for clusters with a kernel version of 24.10.1.11098\_1 or later.


  ><notice>

  This parameter is not supported for clusters that were upgraded to kernel version 24.10.1.11098\_1 or later from an earlier version.

  ></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
- 禁用指定数据库端口，支持传入英文逗号（,）隔开的多个端口。
- 仅内核版本大于等于24.10.1.11098_1的集群支持此参数。
><notice>集群创建时其版本低于24.10.1.11098_1，后期升级到24.10.1.11098_1版本及以上的版本，不支持此参数。</notice>
parameters.name: disable_ports

parameters.help_en:
The network type. Valid values:

- `Vpc`: VPC

- `Public`: public network
parameters.help_zh:
网络类型，取值范围如下：

- Vpc：Vpc网络
- Public：公网
parameters.name: db_instance_net_type
